notes: Product-family vendor read on software.idexx.com as instructed: home, products comparison, Cornerstone product page, Neo product page, Neo features page (titled as the Neo price page but showing no prices), Cornerstone integrations directory (per-integration product tags for Cornerstone, ezyVet and Neo), and IDEXX's own 2025 comparison guide (cited 9 times; dated 'as of April 2025'). The cited 2026 comparison guide answered HTTP 404 (page not found, not a block) and is recorded as read. No price for Cornerstone or Neo appears on any page read, so every Cornerstone and Neo price, price basis, user allowance and 'not published / quote only' claim is unverifiable. C01 groups 'server-based', 'on-premise' and 'runs on a local server' as one claim and classes it true against IDEXX's 'server-based' wording (judgement call); 'desktop' and 'Windows' were kept separate and are unverifiable, as is the claim of hosted, cloud or hybrid Cornerstone options (C02): IDEXX describes Cornerstone only as server-based and lists a managed cloud backup service, which neither states nor rules out hosting. C16 (Cornerstone called a Covetrus system) is wrong; of its four cited pages, lupapets.com and waitwellsoftware.com were read and both attribute Cornerstone to IDEXX; Capterra and G2 were not read, so cause not found. Named IDEXX analyzers (Catalyst, ProCyte, Coag Dx) were treated as examples within the IDEXX in-house diagnostics integration claim (C05), not as separate claims. Statements that IDEXX owns ezyVet were coded under the ezyVet vendor, not here. Animana (C32, C33) is IDEXX software outside the US pages read. Hedged lines ('Neo pricing is similar') and opinions, ratings, setup-time estimates and sync-speed comparisons were not coded. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): the manifest has no browser reads for this vendor and no claim was unverifiable because an own page was blocked or thin (the 2026 guide is a 404, not a block), so nothing was re-classed; re-checking all own snapshots settles none of the unverifiable claims (no Windows, desktop, browser, VetPort, Animana or price text). Gap and table review (including lines that name only 'Neo', which the vendor aliases do not match) added six instances: C03 q4 Google AI Mode 3 (AVImark 'still heavily desktop/on-premise oriented like Cornerstone'); C15 q4 Google AI Overviews 1 and 2 ('Also owned by IDEXX' said of ezyVet in an answer about Cornerstone alternatives, read as stating that Cornerstone is IDEXX's: judgement call); C31 q4 ChatGPT 1 and q5 ChatGPT 1 (Neo for practices 'staying with IDEXX') and q6 Claude 1 ('IDEXX is moving customers toward cloud solutions (ezyVet and Neo)'). Lines that place Neo only 'in the IDEXX ecosystem' were not coded as ownership. 'Secure remote access is available' for Cornerstone was treated as a capability, not a platforms claim. Consistency check: C16 kept wrong; the product's own page names Cornerstone IDEXX practice management software, a direct contradiction of Covetrus ownership on the same fact.
